description: geodata.gelderland.nl: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.gelderland.nl. Coverage: the area served by geodata.gelderland.nl. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Omgevingsvisie- Windenergie uitgesloten vanwege wettelijke beperkingen; Omgevingsvisie- Windenergie aandachtsgebied; Omgevingsverordening - Aandachtsgebied windturbines rondom de Veluwe; Omgevingsvisie- Windenergie uitgesloten vanwege provinciale doelen. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
